Acknowledgments sidebar pane

Source: R/ui_acknowledgments_sidebar_pane.R
acknowledgments_sidebar_pane.Rd

Create a sidebar pane for displaying acknowledgments.

Usage

acknowledgments_sidebar_pane(id, icon = shiny::icon("heart"))

Arguments

id

An id for the sidebar pane.

icon

An [icon()] object for the sidebar pane. This icon is used to create a button for closing the pane. If `NULL`, then no icon is added for the pane.

Value

A `shiny.tag` with sidebar-specific HTML classes

See also

Other sidebar: add_sidebar_control(), contact_sidebar_pane(), sidebar_close(), sidebar_disable(), sidebar_enable(), sidebar_open(), sidebar_pane(), sidebar_tabs()

Examples

# create object
acknowledgments_sidebar_pane("pane_id")
#> <div class="mapsidebar-pane" id="pane_id">
#>   <h3 class="mapsidebar-pane-header mapsidebar-pane-header-icon">
#>     Acknowledgments
#>     <span class="mapsidebar-close">
#>       <i class="far fa-heart" role="presentation" aria-label="heart icon"></i>
#>     </span>
#>   </h3>
#>   <div class="mapsidebar-pane-content">
#>     <div style="padding: 5px">
#>       <p>This project is supported and led by the <a href="https://www.asoc.org/">Antarctic and Southern Ocean Coalition (ASOC)</a>. The <a href="https://doi.org/10.26180/29092346">data</a> and foundations underlying the project were produced during the <a href="https://scar.org/scar-news/scar-iaato-scp">SCAR-IAATO Systematic Conservation Planning Project</a>, which was supported by the <a href="https://iaato.org/">International Association of Antarctica Tour Operators (IAATO)</a>, the <a href="https://scar.org/">Scientific Committee on Antarctic Research (SCAR) and Monash University</a>.</p>
